🔥In Hawaii, to help our Office of Elections do faster audits, a new law removes the requirement to do hand counting of ballots in 10% of the races as a check on the accuracy of the electronic machine ballot counting process. 

🔥So now electronic machines are now checking the ballot scanned  images as the new audit process. This new law is in place now.  Here are two glaring points of potential failures that can be exploited:
1.When ballots are scanned, the scanning settings can be manipulated to affect the quality of the scans.
2.On using an electronic scan reading device, the reading settings can be manipulated affecting the reading quality.
3.Using machines to audit machines will not provide election integrity but the opposite is truer, using electronic counting machines introduces too many points of failure as described above and I only covered two.
